messages:
maya_solutions: Quick heads-up — Stellaron sent an RFI asking for embeddings ratecard, POC assumptions, and network/residency controls. Need a short capability matrix + pricing scenarios. Can we lock answers by EOD Thu?

jordan_sales: On it. Do they want committed tiers or just list card pricing? :thinking_face:

maya_solutions: Include both. Show: hosted (on-demand), committed (3mo/12mo tiers), and private/dedicated options. Call out per-1M-embedding-unit pricing and any egress/licensing assumptions.

liam_engineer: For the technical rows, add: KV/prefix caching supported, embeddings quantization guidance, and expected p95 latency at 1k qps. Also note model variants we recommend for high-throughput embeddings.

maya_solutions: Draft matrix snippet below (please review & edit):
```
Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated (reserved) | Private (VPC/on-prem)
Embedding throughput | up to 2k qps (burst) | predictable up to committed pools | fully customer-provisioned
Data residency | region-level (EU/US) | region-level + tenancy isolation | customer-controlled
KMS / HSM | Redwood-managed KMS (HSM-backed) | option for customer KMS via dedicated integration | BYO HSM (PKCS#11) support
KV / prefix cache | auto prefix caching (best-effort) | configurable cache pools | customer-managed cache placement
Quantization | model-level recommendations + 8-bit supported | custom quantization profiles | full control + profiling tools
SLA | best-effort (hosted) | SLA-backed latency & uptime | negotiated per deployment
Pricing (per 1M embed units) | $40 on-demand | $32 committed (12mo 20% off) | custom (infra + SW license)
```

jordan_sales: Pricing looks reasonable. I'll swap numbers if finance pushes back. Also we should add a one-liner about fallback routing: "automatic fallback to compatible model variant if capacity constrained".

sasha_security: Quick security notes for the RFI: SOC2 Type II (yes), ISO 27001 (in progress), FedRAMP (no). For KMS: hosted = envelope encryption with keys in HSM (Redwood KMS); private = customer-key import via PKCS#11 or KMS integration. Put this exact text in the RFI so legal/security don't reword unexpectedly.

liam_engineer: Implementation note to include: for Private with BYO-HSM we support PKCS#11 + optional HSM attestation. Also add the snippet below for engineers:
```
Private KMS onboarding steps:
1) Exchange public cert + policy
2) PKCS#11 connector deployed in customer VPC
3) Redwood agent authenticates to HSM via mTLS
4) Keys are never exported; envelope keys stored in Redwood control plane
```

maya_solutions: Perfect. Jordan — can you attach the draft capability matrix and pricing spreadsheet to the RFI folder and ping legal & security for a quick pass? I'll compile written answers to the questionnaire.

jordan_sales: Done — draft attached: https://drive.redwood/stellaron/rfi/draft-matrix.xlsx. Pinging @sasha_security @liam_engineer for signoff. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:

sasha_security: Reviewing now. I may tweak wording on data processing addendum and cross-border flows. If Stellaron requires European data residency, we should call out contracts + EU region enforcement.

rfi-bot: Reminder: RFI response deadline — Thursday 18:00 UTC.

maya_solutions: Thanks everyone. If security/legal have edits, drop them in the spreadsheet comments. I'll consolidate final answers and upload to the customer portal by 17:30 UTC.

jordan_sales: I'll prep an executive summary slide that highlights: "predictable SLAs for Dedicated, BYO-HSM option for Private, and committed discounts".

liam_engineer: One more ask from the customer: can we include a short perf benchmark (p95 latency @ 512-dim embeddings) for our recommended model? I can paste a short table if you want.

maya_solutions: Yes — include a one-slide perf appendix. Liam, drop it in the folder when ready. Closing thread once final docs are uploaded. :white_check_mark:
